title: Highlighted Andesite for Create
description: this is a texture pack that makes andesite highlighted to make it easier to spot when mining for it
body: this is a texture pack that makes andesite highlighted to make it easier to spot when mining for it, very useful for people that frequently use the create mod or any mod that requires andesite, or just mining for andesite to build with it. also affects andesite stairs and walls so deactivate it once you're done mining
